modmenu.descriptionTranslation.vulkanplu: High-performance companion optimization mod for VulkanMod.
vulkanplus.options.enabled.tooltip: Enables or disables all Vulkan Plus optimizations globally.
vulkanplus.options.preset.tooltip: Applies curated configuration profiles: Fast (maximum FPS), Balanced (recommended), or Extreme (aggressive culling).
vulkanplus.options.showFps.tooltip: Displays a real-time frames-per-second counter in the top-left corner of the screen.
vulkanplus.options.showDiagnosticsHud.to: Displays technical rendering statistics, pipeline states, and memory metrics on screen (F8).
vulkanplus.options.opaqueLeaves.tooltip: Renders leaf blocks as solid textures and culls hidden inner geometry for a substantial framerate boost in forests.
vulkanplus.options.smartLeaves.tooltip: Culls internal leaf faces occluded by adjacent leaves while preserving transparent foliage.
vulkanplus.options.fastFoliage.tooltip: Cuts cross-model plant geometry by 50%, eliminates random model offset hashing, and culls hidden faces on stacked plants.
vulkanplus.options.foliageDensity.toolti: Deterministic (x, z) density thinning for decorative ground clutter (100%, 75%, 50%, 25%). Never hides gameplay plants.
vulkanplus.options.bufferPooling.tooltip: Reuses pre-allocated Vulkan vertex and staging buffers to reduce memory allocation overhead and frame drops.
vulkanplus.options.descriptorCaching.too: Caches descriptor sets to eliminate redundant bind calls to the GPU driver.
vulkanplus.options.psoCache.tooltip: Caches compiled Vulkan Pipeline State Objects to disk to mitigate shader compilation micro-stutters.
vulkanplus.options.reverseZ.tooltip: Reverses depth buffer coordinates to increase floating-point precision and prevent distant z-fighting.
vulkanplus.options.swapchainTuning.toolt: Optimizes swapchain presentation timings to lower display latency and maintain smooth frame pacing.
vulkanplus.options.presentMode.tooltip: Vulkan presentation sync mode: Mailbox (tear-free low latency), FIFO (vsync), or Immediate (uncapped low latency).
vulkanplus.options.moreCulling.tooltip: Skips rendering entities and block entities outside the camera view frustum or behind terrain.
vulkanplus.options.blockEntityCulling.to: Omits drawing chests, signs, hoppers, and banners that are outside the camera frustum.
Skips rendering block entities when their faces are entirely hidden behind solid opaque blocks.
vulkanplus.options.chestProtection.toolt: Prevents block entity culling on chests near the crosshair to avoid pop-in while interacting.
vulkanplus.options.beaconBeamCulling.too: Culls vertical beacon beam segments that extend beyond the camera view frustum.
vulkanplus.options.beaconProtection.tool: Keeps beacon base structures visible when the player is within range of an active beacon.
vulkanplus.options.extraGlassCulling.too: Culls obscured faces of glass blocks and stained glass panes connecting to adjacent solid blocks.
vulkanplus.options.particleCulling.toolt: Omits rendering particles that are obscured by solid walls or exceed distance thresholds.
vulkanplus.options.fastItemFrames.toolti: Applies directional backface and frustum culling to item frames, speeding up rendering in storage areas.
vulkanplus.options.itemFrameBlockOcclusi: Culls item frames when the surface they are placed against is occluded by adjacent blocks.
vulkanplus.options.threadPriority.toolti: Raises render thread priority and adjusts background worker priorities to prevent frame pacing stutters.
vulkanplus.options.fastMath.tooltip: Utilizes optimized mathematical functions for rendering transformations and vector computations.
vulkanplus.options.fastRandom.tooltip: Replaces standard RNG with a high-performance pseudo-random generator for particle effects.
vulkanplus.options.matrixPooling.tooltip: Reuses Matrix4f transformation objects in the render pipeline to reduce garbage collection pressure.
vulkanplus.options.enableExordium.toolti: Decouples GUI and HUD rendering from world rendering on standalone OpenGL. Disabled by default to protect VulkanMod swapchain from flickering.
vulkanplus.options.hudTargetFps.tooltip: Target refresh rate for in-game HUD (hotbar, health, chat). 30 FPS recommended for maximum performance.
vulkanplus.options.enableScreenPacing.to: Paces container and menu rendering when idle to save GPU power.
vulkanplus.options.screenTargetFps.toolt: Target framerate for menus and containers when idle (30 or 60 FPS).
vulkanplus.options.instantInputResponsiv: Immediately updates screens at native refresh rate during mouse movement or keypresses for 0ms input lag.
vulkanplus.options.dynamicHudUpdates.too: Forces instant HUD redraw whenever taking damage, drowning, receiving chat, or changing hotbar items.
vulkanplus.options.separateCrosshair.too: Renders crosshair and attack recharge meter at full uncapped framerate while the rest of HUD is paced.
vulkanplus.options.bypassInDebugScreen.t: Disables pacing when F3 is open so debug graphs and FPS counters show true real-time world metrics.
vulkanplus.options.fastFadeTransitions.t: Optimizes alpha blending and title screen fade animations during pacing.
vulkanplus.options.noMobAnimations.toolt: Freezes living entity limb, head, and body animations in neutral pose.
vulkanplus.options.noDroppedItemAnimatio: Freezes floating bobbing and rotational spinning on dropped item entities.
vulkanplus.options.staticExpAnimations.t: Freezes color pulsing and trigonometric cycling on experience orbs.
vulkanplus.options.noParticles.tooltip: Completely stops spawning, simulating, and rendering all particles.
vulkanplus.options.noTextureAnimations.t: Freezes animated sprite sheet ticking (water, lava, fire) on frame 0.
vulkanplus.options.noEntityShadows.toolt: Disables projective ground shadows under all entities.
vulkanplus.options.noItemGlint.tooltip: Bypasses the animated purple enchanted foil render pass on items and armor.
vulkanplus.options.noSky.tooltip: Disables celestial sky dome, sun, moon, and star geometry rendering.
vulkanplus.options.noFog.tooltip: Disables atmospheric distance and fluid fog computation.
vulkanplus.options.noBlockEntityAnimatio: Freezes animated block entities such as chest lids, bells, and enchanting tables.
vulkanplus.options.noChunkFade.tooltip: Disables smooth chunk fade transitions and removes distant chunk fog feathering for maximum FPS.
vulkanplus.options.noFogAndFade.tooltip: Completely disables atmospheric distance fog, mountain mist haze, and chunk fade transitions for maximum clarity and FPS.
vulkanplus.options.fastChest.tooltip: Locks chests to solid static block models and completely disables dynamic BlockEntity lid rendering.
vulkanplus.options.shitFoliage.tooltip: Extreme potato foliage: 75% fewer vertices (single quad), flat lighting, 25% clutter density, and 24-block distance culling.
vulkanplus.options.fullBright.tooltip: Bypasses the lighting & AO engine during chunk meshing, skips light-update chunk rebuilds, and locks 100% brightness.
vulkanplus.options.enableC2MeOptimizatio: Enables asynchronous chunk region disk writes and fastutil NBT compound maps.
vulkanplus.options.enableMemoryLeakFix.t: Patches Minecraft memory leaks including Biome ThreadLocal caches and screen target retention.
